title: Parking
description: Test your logic through a hundred of levels that keep getting harder in this puzzle game. Move cars, bus and trailers and find the way to get your vehicle out of a totally crowded parking. An excellent game for the waiting times… in the rush hours! Parking Panic is an amusing game for the whole family! Only recommended for... everyone!
